# wallix.bastion.authdomain_azuread

Manage Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) authentication domains on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.1.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete an authentication domain of type `AzureAD` on a WALLIX Bastion.
- An authentication domain is a user directory. Users of the domain log in through its external authentications (Microsoft Entra ID configured as a SAML identity provider, see [`wallix.bastion.externalauth_saml`](externalauth_saml.md)), and get their Bastion user groups from the mappings of the domain, see [`wallix.bastion.authdomain_mapping`](authdomain_mapping.md).
- The Bastion signs in to Microsoft Entra ID (OAuth client credentials) as the app registration given by [`client_id`](#parameter-client-id), [`entity_id`](#parameter-entity-id) and [`client_secret`](#parameter-client-secret) (or [`certificate`](#parameter-certificate) and [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key)). It does so when the domain is created, so creation fails if these credentials are wrong or the Bastion cannot reach Microsoft Entra ID.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread` Terraform resource.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-auth-domain-name"></a>**auth_domain_name** | `str` | Name of the directory domain, for example `corp.example.com`.<br>Required when the domain does not exist yet. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-certificate"></a>**certificate** | `str` | Certificate of the app registration, to authenticate with a certificate instead of [`client_secret`](#parameter-client-secret).<br>Treated as a secret, never returned and never compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-client-id"></a>**client_id** | `str` | Application (client) ID of the app registration the Bastion uses to read the groups of the users.<br>Required when the domain does not exist yet. |
| <a id="parameter-client-secret"></a>**client_secret** | `str` | Client secret of the app registration.<br>Treated as a secret, never returned and never compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-default-email-domain"></a>**default_email_domain** | `str` | Email domain given to users of the domain without an email address, for example `example.com`.<br>Required when the domain does not exist yet. |
| <a id="parameter-default-language"></a>**default_language** | `str` | Language given to users of the domain without a language.<br>Required when the domain does not exist yet.<br><br>Choices: `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `ru` |
| <a id="parameter-description"></a>**description** | `str` | Description of the domain. |
| <a id="parameter-domain-name"></a>**domain_name** | `str` / required | Name of the authentication domain. Identifies the domain on the Bastion.<br>The module fails if a domain of this name exists with another type (AD, LDAP, SAML). |
| <a id="parameter-entity-id"></a>**entity_id** | `str` | Directory (tenant) ID of the Microsoft Entra ID tenant.<br>Required when the domain does not exist yet. |
| <a id="parameter-external-auths"></a>**external_auths** | `list / elements=str` | Names of the external authentications (Microsoft Entra ID SAML identity providers) users of the domain authenticate against, in the order they are tried.<br>They must exist and all be of the same type.<br>Required when the domain does not exist yet. The list replaces the current one. |
| <a id="parameter-is-default"></a>**is_default** | `bool` | Whether this is the default authentication domain, used when users log in without a domain. |
| <a id="parameter-label"></a>**label** | `str` | Text of the button users click on the login page to authenticate with this domain.<br>Required when the domain does not exist yet. |
| <a id="parameter-passphrase"></a>**passphrase** | `str` | Passphrase of [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key).<br>Treated as a secret, never returned and never compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-private-key"></a>**private_key** | `str` | Private key of [`certificate`](#parameter-certificate).<br>Treated as a secret, never returned and never compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-secondary-auth"></a>**secondary_auth** | `list / elements=str` | Names of the external authentications used as a second authentication factor, in order.<br>The list replaces the current one; `[]` removes them all. |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the domain should exist.<br>The Bastion refuses to delete a domain that still has mappings; remove them first with [`wallix.bastion.authdomain_mapping`](authdomain_mapping.md).<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-update-password"></a>**update_password** | `str` | `on_create` sends [`client_secret`](#parameter-client-secret), [`certificate`](#parameter-certificate), [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key) and [`passphrase`](#parameter-passphrase) only when the domain is created.<br>`always` sends them on every run, which then always reports a change.<br><br>Choices: `always`, `on_create` (default) |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Let users log in with Microsoft Entra ID
  wallix.bastion.authdomain_azuread:
    domain_name: corp-entra
    auth_domain_name: corp.onmicrosoft.com
    default_email_domain: example.com
    default_language: en
    external_auths: [entra-saml]
    label: Sign in with Microsoft
    client_id: 87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321
    entity_id: 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012
    client_secret: "{{ entra_client_secret }}"

- name: Rotate the client secret
  wallix.bastion.authdomain_azuread:
    domain_name: corp-entra
    client_secret: "{{ new_entra_client_secret }}"
    update_password: always

- name: Remove the domain
  wallix.bastion.authdomain_azuread:
    domain_name: corp-entra
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-authdomain"></a>**authdomain** | `dict` | The authentication domain as returned by the Bastion API after the change, without the secret options.<br>In check mode, the expected domain. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-authdomain) |
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated.<br>Contains the secret options sent because of [`update_password=always`](#parameter-update-password).<br><br>Returned: when the domain already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["label"]` |

### Sample of `authdomain`

```yaml
auth_domain_name: corp.onmicrosoft.com
client_id: 87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321
default_email_domain: example.com
default_language: en
description: ''
domain_name: corp-entra
entity_id: 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012
external_auths:
- entra-saml
id: 1a0f76784f6e92be005056b66c8b
is_default: false
label: Sign in with Microsoft
mappings: []
secondary_auth: []
type: AzureAD
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/authdomains/1a0f76784f6e92be005056b66c8b
```
